name: forge-cli-workspace
description: Forge CLI development workspace and installable GitHub package

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s python/tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.release:check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && python3 -m pip wheel ./python --no-deps --no-cache-dir -w /tmp/forge-wheel-check
